artifact.title: Architectural Change Preservation
artifact.purpose: Govern preservation of accepted architectural changes.
statement: Every accepted major architectural change shall immediately produce a canonical JSON artifact.
The JSON shall be created before subsequent architectural work continues.
The change shall be entered into the applicable index artifacts at the next preservation checkpoint.
The JSON is the authoritative record of the decision; conversation history is explanatory only.
artifact.rationale: Small, frequent preservation reduces reconstruction cost and creates a reproducible design history.
